msgs.txt:
Can't find the sound you need? These are the prompts we use, written out so you can paste them into a music or sound generator and get something usable on the first try.

BGM prompts — 10 moods, each with instrumentation, tempo and length already specified
SFX prompts — 7 categories, with the wording that actually produces a clean short clip instead of a music loop

Works with Suno, Stable Audio, ElevenLabs and most others. The full sheets are in the replies below — copy straight from there, no download.

Two things that matter more than the prompt itself:
1 · Always turn on Instrumental (no lyrics). Vocals fight the text on screen.
2 · Save with the suggested file name. Frontia's AI matches a sound to a situation by its asset name, so tension_chase gets picked up and track_03 does not.

Made something good with these? Post it here — that's what this channel is for.
